## Summary

Dovecote Learning Ltd (policy CC-1629): theft overnight from a locked office of a soldering station and an oscilloscope at a rented studio on Pike Street. Covered under clause 4.2; reserve 5,876 dollars.

## Facts

Dovecote Learning Ltd reported the loss on 16 April 2026 under policy CC-1629 [notice of loss]. The loss was theft from a locked office overnight [notice of loss]. It occurred at a rented studio on Pike Street [notice of loss]. The items are a soldering station [invoice 1] and an oscilloscope [invoice 2]. The theft was reported to the police on 18 April 2026 under reference CR/2026/4221 [police report]. The items were in a locked container at the time [police report]. The invoices are for 4,829 dollars [invoice 1] and 1,047 dollars [invoice 2].

## Coverage analysis

The loss falls under clause 4.2 of the policy, which covers loss of or damage to business contents at the premises named in the schedule, and at any other premises while in the insured's custody, caused by theft [policy].

- **Exclusion 7.1 (unattended property)** does not apply. It removes cover for theft of portable equipment left unattended in a shared or public space unless it was in a locked container or locked room. The items were in a locked container, and the theft was from a locked office [police report], [notice of loss], [policy].
- **Exclusion 7.5 (unproven loss)** does not apply on the file as it stands. It removes cover where theft is alleged and the loss was not reported to the police within seven days. The police report is dated 18 April 2026, two days after the notice of loss on 16 April 2026 [police report], [notice of loss], [policy]. The file does not state the date of the theft itself, so the seven-day period is measured here from the notice of loss.
- **Exclusion 7.3 (wear and tear)** does not apply. The loss is a theft, and no gradual deterioration is described [notice of loss], [policy].

Two points are not in the file and should be noted. The policy schedule is not in the file, so I cannot confirm whether the Pike Street studio is a named premises. The file also does not state who holds the studio, so I cannot confirm the insured's custody there other than through the notice of loss and police report, which both place the loss at the studio [notice of loss], [police report].

## Decision

Covered under clause 4.2. The claim is accepted.

## Reserve

The reserve is 5,876 dollars, the sum of the two invoices (4,829 dollars and 1,047 dollars) [invoice 1], [invoice 2]. No excess is shown in the file, and under clause 9.1 none applies where the schedule shows none [policy].
